items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) biggest QUESTIONABLE on slate; affects Herbert projections heavily. Game at 4pm ET so late confirmation. Practiced Fri after DNPs.
items.why: Rib injury Week 1 exit; missed early practices, limited/returned Fri; Schefter/ETR confirm Q.
items.implication: If active reduced floor; if OUT major Herbert downgrade + Johnston/Harris boost. Monitor inactives.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets shift to Quentin Johnston if OUT; Herbert volume compressed if limited.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 2 vs CIN after missing Thu/Fri practice; not believed serious but history of multi-week hamstring absences. HOU WR room thinned further with prior losses.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated in Wed practice; DNP Thu/Fri; official ruling Fri.
items.implication: Remove from all lineups; HOU pass game volume to secondary WRs/TEs.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers (Schultz primary TE stream).

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) listed DOUBTFUL for Week 2 vs NO after limited Fri return following two DNPs; Ja'Kobi Lane also out (IR wrist). Plan without him.
items.why: Hamstring exit Week 1; missed Wed/Thu, limited Fri; official doubtful.
items.implication: Sit; BAL WR hierarchy collapses to Bateman/Walker/etc crumbs.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share/routes for Mark Andrews and remaining BAL WRs; Lamar still viable but less explosive.

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee/meniscus) DOUBTFUL for Week 2 vs LAC per HC; returned limited Fri post-surgery but unlikely to play. Prepare healthy TE alternative.
items.why: Meniscus surgery earlier; limited Fri practice; HC designation.
items.implication: Do not start; LV TE thin, Mayer fringe option.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer or other streamers gain if OUT; Jeanty/RB usage unaffected primarily.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson IN for 2026 debut; Patriots desperate for playmakers (AJ Brown IR). Potential 10+ touches vs Stevenson; strong upcoming schedule before bye.
items.why: Full practice/ready comments; ETR IN list; AJ Brown absence creates need.
items.implication: Flex upside; monitor split with Stevenson (who retains floor).
items.opportunity: Carries/routes expansion possible in NE backfield; explosive playmaker role.
items.conflict: Stevenson still primary early-down; not full takeover expected immediately.

items.text: Joe Burrow (back) QUESTIONABLE but said he's playing; listed Q on report. Full practice context positive.
items.why: Self-reported playing; Schefter notes Q designation despite comments.
items.implication: Start with confidence; CIN offense full if active.
items.opportunity: Full snap/routes for Chase/Higgins if cleared.

items.text: Alvin Kamara IN (knee); expected back, squeezing Etienne/Miller committee further in pass/early downs.
items.why: ETR IN list after prior Q; expected return.
items.implication: Kamara RB2/flex; Etienne downgrade to committee/bench.
items.opportunity: Kamara third-down/pass work; Etienne early-down split with Miller reduced.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE: 74% snap/21-of-24 RB touches through 3Q Week 1, 40% routes targeted (team lead), 24% tgt share. Elite matchup vs IND (gave 163 yds/3 TD to Henry).
items.why: Dominant Week 1 utilization + soft matchup; 10 Facts notes 24% tgt share career-high range.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 upside; RB1 overall in range of outcomes if healthy.
items.opportunity: High snap share, target share, red-zone/carry volume.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan league lead), 19% tgt share last 10, 25+ touches 3-of-4 recent. Road @ LAC favorable.
items.why: Elite utilization under Kubiak; passing-game involvement sustained.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex start; overreaction to prior injury scare.
items.opportunity: High utilization, target share, touch volume.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE: Career-high 26% tgt share Week 1, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8; good matchup vs CLE (121 rush yds allowed).
items.implication: RB2/flex start; clear lead over Gainwell.

items.text: Justin Jefferson LOVE with Wentz: 37% tgt share Week 1, 93 yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career Wentz games; CHI defense allowed 10+ YPT last week.
items.why: Volume with Wentz starter (Murray OUT); matchup data.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey getting usage bump off Week 1 regardless; Kaelon Black (groin) Q status still matters for SF RB shares.
items.implication: CMC strong start; monitor Black for any handcuff/role dip.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/route share for CMC; Black limited if active.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE (27% tgt/13.7 aDOT Week 1, TEN soft secondary); Dak Prescott LOVE vs WAS (home PPG, high total, WAS torched Week 1).
items.why: Usage/aDOT + matchup for Smith; implied total/home/efficiency for Dak.

items.text: Travis Etienne HATE: Matched Miller rushes Week 1, 69% fantasy pts via air; Kamara return squeezes pass role further; underdog script bad for rush.
items.why: Committee squeeze confirmed with Kamara IN; poor Week 1 split.
items.opportunity: Reduced carries/targets with Kamara back for third downs.
